greeting: Hello, Release Radars! Ready to dive into this week's plugin happenings?
introParagraph: This week, the plugin landscape offered a nice mix, proving that even a quieter period can bring significant improvements. While fixes took center stage, we saw some exciting new features that promise to streamline workflows and enhance user experience, particularly in the realm of payments and form management. It seems developers are busy refining the tools that power our WordPress sites!

highlights.title: WP Simple Pay 4.17.4
highlights.summary: WP Simple Pay introduced a brand new Transactions page for browsing and exporting one-time payments, alongside the much-anticipated ability to issue full or partial refunds directly from the transaction detail view. This is a game-changer for anyone managing payments, making life significantly easier for store owners.

highlights.title: WPForms Lite 2.0.2
highlights.summary: WPForms Lite unveiled a sleek new Dashboard, now the first page you see, offering at-a-glance form views and helpful next steps. While primarily a fix-focused release, this dashboard addition is a welcome improvement for quick form management and insights.

highlights.title: Easy Digital Downloads 3.7.1
highlights.summary: Easy Digital Downloads has integrated its store data with WordPress's Abilities API, empowering AI assistants to discover and interact with orders, customers, products, and discounts more effectively. This paves the way for exciting new automation and management possibilities within EDD.

highlights.title: All in One SEO 5.0.2
highlights.summary: All in One SEO has bumped its minimum required PHP version to 7.4, ensuring better performance and security. They also tackled database query optimization, which means snappier admin page loads – a win for everyone's sanity!
